texts: When a sky-cat descends, the sky-cat hunts nightmoths.
When a sky-cat hunts nightmoths at a lantern-row, the nightmoth crowd at that lantern-row shrinks.
Whenever a sky-cat hunts nightmoths at a lantern-row, the nightmoth crowd at that lantern-row thins.
After a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, the thread harvest at that lantern-row falls.

fields.sentence: When a sky-cat descends, the sky-cat hunts nightmoths.

review.notes: Rule shape, coreference of "the sky-cat" to the premise variable, and the solid-spelling genus for nightmoth are all as specified; an animate self-powered mover correctly keeps Agent on the intransitive descend. The bare-plural object "nightmoths" as a kind filler is the licensed non-specific reading rather than a per-occurrence group witness, which is defensible for a habitual conclusion.

fields.sentence: When a sky-cat hunts nightmoths at a lantern-row, the nightmoth crowd at that lantern-row shrinks.
parse: (: skycat_hunt_shrinks_crowd (Implication (And (Member $x sky_cat) (Member $r lantern_row) (Member $e hunt) (Agent $e $x) (Theme $e nightmoth) (Location $e $r)) (And (Member (sk_crowd $r) crowd) (GroupOf (sk_crowd $r) nightmoth) (LocatedIn (sk_crowd $r) $r) (Member (sk_shrink $e) shrink) (Theme (sk_shrink $e) (sk_crowd $r)) (During (sk_shrink $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Theme on shrinks sits between the internal-change-of-state route (Patient, cf. the listed spread) and the scalar-change route (Theme), and the latter explicitly licenses Theme, so it is not scored as a defect. The nightmoth crowd is encoded as collective noun plus GroupOf rather than a fused nightmoth_crowd, which follows the flock-of-birds pattern.

fields.sentence: Whenever a sky-cat hunts nightmoths at a lantern-row, the nightmoth crowd at that lantern-row thins.
parse: (: whenever_hunt_thin (Implication (And (Member $x sky_cat) (Member $l lantern_row) (Member $h hunt) (Agent $h $x) (Patient $h nightmoth) (Location $h $l)) (And (Member (sk_crowd $l) crowd) (GroupOf (sk_crowd $l) nightmoth) (LocatedIn (sk_crowd $l) $l) (Member (sk_thin $h) thin) (Patient (sk_thin $h) (sk_crowd $l)) (During (sk_thin $h) $h))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: A presupposed DEFINITE referent that first appears in a rule's consequent and depends on a premise variable ('the nightmoth crowd at that lantern-row'): the instruction set gives projection rules for definites inside seals and strength-0 denial bundles but none for rule consequents, so the crowd's existence, kind and location end up conditioned on a hunt occurring.
review.notes: The whenever machinery, per-occurrence Skolem event, During link, absence of a QuantifierPhrase companion and the (STV 1.0 0.9) all match the instruction set; 'at' correctly yields event Location in the premise and entity-attached LocatedIn on the crowd.

fields.sentence: After a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, the thread harvest at that lantern-row falls.
parse: (: hunt_fall_rule (Implication (And (Member $h hunt) (Agent $h $c) (Member $c sky_cat) (Location $h $l) (Member $l lantern_row)) (And (Member (sk_fall $h) fall) (Theme (sk_fall $h) (sk_harvest $l)) (Member (sk_harvest $l) thread_harvest) (LocatedIn (sk_harvest $l) $l) (Before $h (sk_fall $h)))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

q2_gaps: a generic conditional headed by 'after' rather than 'when / whenever / every time': the occurrence-quantifying rule form is specified only for those wordings and fixes 'During' as the trigger link, so there is no stated form for a response that FOLLOWS its trigger (here supplied by a conclusion-internal 'Before')
review.notes: Compound genus atoms (sky_cat/lantern_row/thread_harvest), Location for 'at', Theme for the scalar-change subject, entity-attached LocatedIn for 'at that lantern-row', and plain-variable premises all follow the instruction set. The definite 'the thread harvest' has its typing and LocatedIn only in the conclusion, which is unavoidable since it depends on a rule variable — no top-level projection exists for that case.
